name: @skillable/command-and-keep-server
description: Skillable flagship runtime: six MCP tools over the Command & Keep skill pack and an evidence ledger

scripts.bundle:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/skillable-mcp.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from \"node:module\"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:cli:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/skillable-cli.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from \"node:module\"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run bundle:cli
